title: IINA: free Infuse Pro alternative
caption:
Infuse Pro charges $16.99/year to play videos on your Mac. IINA does it for free 🎬

✅ Subtitles built in, including online subtitle search
✅ Picture-in-Picture and trackpad gestures, made for macOS
✅ Video thumbnails and unlimited playback history
✅ No tracking, no telemetry, no subscription

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Mac only (macOS 12+, macOS 11 on Intel). Infuse also runs on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, which IINA doesn't; Infuse's $16.99/year is its Pro plan (basic Infuse is free)

Comment "MOVIE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
